verdict.rationale: Activepieces is an AI-enabled automation platform, so a no-training privacy posture is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no statement that customer data is excluded from model training. Bring-your-own AI keys, self-hosting, and an EU cloud option are adjacent deployment and governance features, not a documented guarantee or control over model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
